project: Health Sciences Simulation Lab Drainage Improvements, Northeast Texas Community College
numbering_note: Section number without spaces, a decimal point, then a sequential number (061000.01). Resubmittals add a decimal point and an alphabetic suffix (061000.01.A).
copies_format: Product data: two hard copies and one electronic copy. Shop drawings: two opaque copies, sheets 8-1/2 x 11 up to 30 x 40 inches. Transmit each submittal with its own transmittal form (AIA G810 or approved equal). Progress schedule: six copies plus one PDF.
division01_notes: Initial review is 15 days (about 2.1 weeks) from the Architect's receipt, and resubmittal review is another 15 days. Review time is the default on the Register sheet; change it on this sheet.
No extension of Contract Time is allowed for submittals sent too late to be processed, including resubmittals.
Resubmit until the submittal is marked No Exception Taken. Use only final submittals marked No Exceptions Taken for construction.
All submittals go through the Contractor. The Architect returns submittals received from any other source without review.
Package each submittal individually and transmit it with a transmittal form.
Highlight, encircle or otherwise identify deviations from the Contract Documents.
Substitution requests and comparable product requests (Section 01 60 00) are contractor-initiated and are not in this register.
Prep time of 1 week is an assumption, not a spec requirement.
